methods.name: Exact BRC Newton residual fiber-sum operation-safe quotient
capabilities: map fixed source Taylor positions to exact residual (scale,degree) coordinates
return within-fiber transfer generators and exact rank/kernel dimensions
project to the weaker current edge-only observer
apply one exact within-fiber provenance transfer
typed_inputs: finite labeled source Taylor positions with source scales and degrees
methods.hard_boundary: Minimality is for the complete residual Newton-jet observer only. Edge-only or provenance-sensitive observers have different quotients. Different residual scales or Taylor degrees do not merge. Algebraic coefficient cancellation is not signed branch-mass cancellation.

methods.name: Weighted BRC CWM / log-multiplicity calculus
capabilities: exact positive-rational branch recoalescence and propagation through one CWM carrier
effective multiplicity E=W/M and symbolic BRC LN surplus readout
projective future scaling and incoming-weight compensation
one-state multi-loop exact recurrence and stable geometric closure
typed deterministic degeneration with E=1 and zero log surplus
methods.core_law: Positive finite branch systems carry CWM=(C,W,M) with alternative recoalescence (+,+,max) and serial propagation by componentwise multiplication; E=W/M and Delta=ln(E) measure multiplicity beyond the dominant path. Equal k-way recoalescence has Delta=ln k. For one-state loops total mass is stable iff S=sum q_i<1, not merely max q_i<1.
methods.hard_boundary: Positive Weighted-BRC does not represent signed/amplitude cancellation, does not recover erased branch provenance from Boolean support, does not make LN/LOG primitive state, and does not provide a general SCC/Perron-Frobenius/spectral-radius theorem. Deterministic single-path problems reduce to E=1, Delta=0 and should not be artificially reinterpreted as multiplicity problems.

methods.name: Exact BRC Newton observer lattice and frozen-horizon observability
capabilities: construct canonical coordinate-projection observers on T56 residual coordinates
compute observer signatures, equivalence, joins, meets and rank/kernel dimensions
compare full-residual and edge-only safe quotients
apply exact rational Newton substitutions for a declared frozen schedule
compute scale-one edge signatures over a finite declared horizon
construct exact observability matrices and prefix rank/kernel profiles
typed_inputs: declared frozen Newton schedule of rational roots, positive multiplicities and RationalValuationScale factors
methods.hard_boundary: Coordinate observers do not classify arbitrary nonlinear observers. Frozen scheduled substitutions do not certify that perturbed states autonomously select the same roots, multiplicities or scales. Longer declared horizons can only refine or preserve the safe quotient.

methods.name: Operation-family quotient closure and safe-operation census
BRC multiplier square-content scan reduction
capabilities: exact one-shot stripping of every multiplier square factor whose root divides the known BRC ceiling root
exact immediate-ceiling witness preservation under m->m/g^2 and x->x/g
same gcd-factor preservation under declared gcd(n,m)=1
canonical reuse of m=a^2 d squarefree decomposition
composition with the existing exact odd-N 2-adic state representative
state-level IRREDUNDANT/REDUCED/IMPOSSIBLE classification before gap squarehood testing
methods.core_law: Write m=a^2 d with d squarefree and x=ceil(sqrt(mn)). Under gcd(n,m)=1, g=gcd(a,x) divides the square root y of every successful completion gap y^2=x^2-mn. Dividing m,x,y by g^2,g,g yields the exact immediate ceiling witness at m/g^2, and gcd(x-y,n)=gcd(x/g-y/g,n). After this one-shot normalization gcd(a/g,x/g)=1, so all square content visible in the current ceiling root has been removed.
methods.hard_boundary: Requires an already-known exact ceiling root and declared gcd(n,m)=1; a nontrivial multiplier gcd should be handled as a factor witness before this reduction. Squareful multipliers are not statically discardable: states with gcd(square-content-root,ceiling-root)=1 can be genuine first hits. Common-factor scaling is elementary prior art; no novelty priority, asymptotic factorization speedup, or Foundation promotion is claimed.

methods.name: BRC phase quotient/remainder transport
capabilities: exact five-phase transport of divmod(2*h*J,4*m+h) on the common order-one deep tail
two direct seed divmods per mod-8 source phase followed by recurrence-only quotient generation
proved phase second-difference bounds -3..51 for h=1 and -3..99 for h=2
exact product-free residual recurrence using retained roots, quotients and division remainders
512-entry 10-bit normalized lower reciprocal table with 1024-byte logical raw payload
proved non-negative correction estimate within at most one plus one exact comparison
optional large-integer backend that composes with the order-one linear BRC tail and staged square-gap cascade
methods.core_law: For one fixed mod-8 phase, S_h(m)=2h*sqrt(mN)/(4m+h) has 0<=Delta_8^2 S_h<=48h on 4m^5>=N. Since q_h=floor(2h*floor(sqrt(mN))/(4m+h)) differs from S_h by less than 2, its exact integer second difference is in [-3,51] for h=1 and [-3,99] for h=2. With X_i=q_i D_i+r_i and D_(i+1)=D_i+32, the residual relative to qhat=2q_i-q_(i-1) is rho=2h(J_(i+1)-2J_i+J_(i-1))+2r_i-r_(i-1)+64(q_(i-1)-q_i), so the next quotient/remainder follows from only a bounded correction. A 10-bit upper-bucket reciprocal seed estimates each non-negative correction from below within one.
methods.hard_boundary: Exact only on the already-certified common order-one deep tail and increasing odd-N mod-8 representative stream. Native big-integer division remains faster in the measured 1024/2048-bit Python cohorts; the tracker is an optional large-integer long-stream backend with a runtime-dependent crossover. It does not reduce the multiplier horizon, alter factorization complexity, or imply RSA practicality.

methods.name: Diagonal-translation quotient / min-zero canonicalization

In current Enterprise geometry it is admitted for the separately typed derived G1 displacement layer A_D/G_D and is forbidden as an automatic primitive native-point A_E quotient. No new T-family is created.

methods.name: Exact quotient-root atlas and ternary state-count carry operator
capabilities: compute the exact state-specific coalescence horizon and high-denominator cutoff
certify the high injective chart and contiguous forced low-root chart
compute exact distinct quotient-root state cardinality without a full denominator scan
certify the unique optional horizon state by a binary boundary carry
compress the exact count to a three-valued threshold carry
materialize the compressed root-state atlas for regression or downstream finite reasoning
methods.core_law: For n>=1 and r>=1, with H=R_(r+1)(r*n-1) and D=floor(n/(H+1)^r), the quotient-root atlas R_r(floor(n/d)), 1<=d<=n, is the disjoint union of an injective D-state high chart and the forced low interval 1..H-1 plus at most the horizon H. Hence |S|+1=D+H+kappa; with q=floor(H/r) the three-point D-band compresses this to |S|+1=H+q+tau with tau in {0,1,2} selected by two exact thresholds.
methods.hard_boundary: DOMAIN_OPERATOR only. The carrier is the finite positive-denominator quotient-root atlas. Do not generalize to arbitrary floor maps or quotient semigroups, do not infer prime/factoring/Legendre or continuum claims, do not erase the H=0 branch, and do not treat the ternary state-count carry as a universal T5 carry law. No Foundation mutation follows.

methods.name: Predictive minimality versus capacity-bound guard
capabilities: distinguish redundant-state minimization from height bounds
use J_m chain family as exact negative control for hidden capacity assumptions
methods.hard_boundary: A coarsest future-predictive quotient can still have arbitrarily large finite transient depth. Minimality/completeness alone never supplies a fixed state-count or height bound.
